title: Correct CurrReport.Skip guidance and retire false fixture expectations
summary: Corrects BCQuality reporting guidance that wrongly assumed statements after CurrReport.Skip() keep running in the same OnAfterGetRecord trigger. The Skip article was replaced under a new name, its false sample pair and fixture registration were retired, and the reporting review skill no longer flags that cue.
key_points: Corrected the false claim that code after CurrReport.Skip() keeps running in the same trigger
Replaced the Skip article with one that separates same-trigger exit from later trigger dispatch, next-record processing, child traversal and dataset omission
Retired the false bad/good sample pair and its evaluation fixture registration
The reporting review skill drops the same-trigger-after-Skip cue but keeps the later-trigger concern
The Break article wording was refined; its samples are unchanged
